invariants.statement: AI agents cannot self-certify. An AI assertion cannot create PL VERIFIED.
invariants.scope: All verification and proof claims in CANON/PL workflows.
invariants.authority: CANON constitution (RFC-002 §6 I1); enforced by the PL verifier, never by the AI.
invariants.enforcement_point: PL verify pipeline: only PL execution may emit VERIFIED. The canon CLI has no command that writes a verification verdict.
invariants.violation_behavior: Fail-closed: any record attempting to assert verification state is rejected (exit 4); existing claims are untouched; the attempt is ledgered.
invariants.evidence_method: Attempt `canon add-principle ... verified=true` → rejected as unknown field; audit PL code for absence of any mark_proven path.

points.note: CLI command list: no command writes a verification verdict
command dispatch: same closed set
allowed_fields: no verdict/verified field exists in any schema-2 allowlist

invariants.statement: UNKNOWN is the default. Missing evidence never becomes positive state through inference.
invariants.scope: All CANON queries, context receipts, and status derivations.
invariants.authority: CANON constitution (RFC-002 §6 I2); enforced by canon search/context/audit.
invariants.enforcement_point: canon search with no match prints an explicit NO ACTIVE DECISION FOUND marker; context receipt marks unavailable PL state as UNKNOWN, never blank.
invariants.violation_behavior: Fail-closed: queries return an explicit UNKNOWN marker; no empty-success path exists.
invariants.evidence_method: Run `canon search <gibberish>` → exit 0 with NO ACTIVE DECISION FOUND marker on stdout.

points.note: search with no match prints explicit NO ACTIVE DECISION FOUND marker
unavailable PL state marked UNKNOWN, never blank

invariants.statement: Evidence is not proof. Evidence exists independently of verification.
invariants.scope: The CANON↔PL boundary; all claim/evidence references.
invariants.enforcement_point: Schema allowlist: CANON records have no verification-verdict field; context receipt queries PL live instead of caching verdicts.
invariants.violation_behavior: Fail-closed: append with a verdict-like field is rejected as an unknown field (exit 4).
invariants.evidence_method: Attempt `canon add-principle ... verified=true` → exit 2, argument rejected and never silently dropped; store-level unknown fields → exit 4.

points.note: allowed_fields: schema allowlist, no verification-verdict field
validate_new: unknown field -> StoreError::Semantic (exit 4)
reject_unknown: unknown CLI args rejected (exit 2), never silently dropped

invariants.statement: Verification executes. VERIFIED requires execution of an authorized verification procedure.
invariants.scope: PL verification lifecycle; CANON's surfacing of PL state.
invariants.authority: CANON constitution (RFC-002 §6 I4); procedure owned by the PL lane.
invariants.enforcement_point: Context receipt surfaces PL FAILED dimensions as violations (V2); CANON never emits VERIFIED itself.
invariants.violation_behavior: Degrade-open on read, closed on write: receipt marks PL state UNKNOWN when the pl binary is unavailable; no verdict is invented.
invariants.evidence_method: Rename the pl binary away → `canon context` prints the unavailable-PL UNKNOWN marker.

points.note: PL FAILED dimensions surfaced as violations; CANON never emits VERIFIED itself

invariants.statement: Corruption is visible. Malformed canonical state cannot silently disappear.
invariants.authority: CANON constitution (RFC-002 §6 I5, §23-24); enforced by canon audit.
invariants.enforcement_point: canon audit: read_strict fails on any malformed line; verify_chain fails on any hash/prev_hash mismatch (exit 3).
invariants.violation_behavior: Fail-closed: audit exits 3; no partial or skipped-and-continued results are trusted.
invariants.evidence_method: Hash-chain suite (tests/hashchain.rs): corruption, mid-file truncation, duplicate, malformed-record cases all green.

points.note: read_strict: fails on any malformed line
verify_chain: fails on any hash/prev_hash mismatch (exit 3)

invariants.statement: History is immutable. Historical decisions and evidence are not rewritten.
invariants.scope: All CANON stores and their git history.
invariants.enforcement_point: Append-only CLI surface (no update/delete command exists); duplicate-id rejection; fs2 exclusive lock serializes writers; fsync before success.
invariants.violation_behavior: No CLI path can mutate history; direct file edits are detected by audit (exit 3).
invariants.evidence_method: Enumerate CLI commands — no update/delete; tamper test → `canon audit` FAIL exit 3.

points.note: append: exclusive fs2 lock serializes writers, fsync before success
CLI surface: no update/delete command exists
duplicate-id guard: no silent mutation

invariants.statement: Supersession is explicit. Replacing a requirement creates a new record linked to the old one.
invariants.scope: Record lifecycle for constitution, contracts, decisions.
invariants.enforcement_point: canon supersede requires both endpoint ids to exist plus a reason; effective_status surfaces SUPERSEDED in search and context receipts.
invariants.violation_behavior: Dangling endpoints rejected (exit 4); superseded records are never returned as active (C12).
invariants.evidence_method: `canon supersede from=NOPE to=X reason=y` → exit 4; search output always carries the [STATUS] tag.

points.note: cmd_supersede: requires from= to= reason=
both endpoints must exist; dangling rejected (exit 4)

invariants.statement: Source truth and runtime truth differ. A source artifact cannot prove runtime behavior.
invariants.scope: Context receipts; any reasoning about deployed behavior.
invariants.enforcement_point: Receipt records git revision AND working_tree state AND live PL state as three separate fields.
invariants.violation_behavior: Receipt never conflates them: revision, DIRTY/CLEAN, and PL dimensions are printed on separate lines.
invariants.evidence_method: `canon context` output contains distinct `revision:`, `working_tree:`, and CURRENT PL STATE sections.

points.note: revision: git revision printed as its own field
working_tree: DIRTY/CLEAN printed as its own field; live PL state separate

invariants.statement: Deployment and implementation differ. Compilation cannot prove deployment.
invariants.enforcement_point: Receipt PL STATE section separates implemented/deployed/proven per claim; no single done field exists in any schema.
invariants.violation_behavior: Schema allowlist contains no done/deployed shortcut fields; any such field is rejected on append.
invariants.evidence_method: Inspect schema-2 allowlists (store.rs allowed_fields) — no completion-shortcut fields present.

points.note: allowed_fields: no done/deployed/shipped shortcut field exists in any allowlist

invariants.statement: Shipped has a formal definition: implemented VERIFIED and deployed VERIFIED and proven VERIFIED.
invariants.scope: Release gating across the thesis-defense work order.
invariants.authority: CANON constitution (RFC-002 §6 I10); work-order §B7. Computed by the PL lane.
invariants.enforcement_point: CANON records the rule; PL computes overall=shipped. Receipt REQUIRED NEXT ACTION names the blocking dimension.
invariants.violation_behavior: CANON cannot declare shipped — no command or field exists for it; receipt degrades to naming the next action.
invariants.evidence_method: pl status --json overall field transitions only via PL verification events, never via CANON writes.

points.note: canon side (negative): no shipped field exists; CANON cannot declare shipped
canon side (negative): no declare-shipped command exists

enforcement.scope_note: Positive enforcement (PL computes overall=shipped) lives in ~/workspace/proof-ledger, out of canon scope and read-only per lane brief. Canon-side enforcement is the negative above: no field, no command, no path to declare shipped.

invariants.statement: Deterministic core. Truth determination MUST NOT depend on generative AI.
invariants.scope: canon binary, audit, context receipts, hashing, tests.
invariants.enforcement_point: Pure Rust, zero network, zero model calls; context(A)==context(A) is testable; receipt carries context_hash.
invariants.violation_behavior: Any nondeterminism is a defect: receipt determinism is covered by an automated test.
invariants.evidence_method: cargo test: receipt determinism + canonical-encoding determinism cases green; two `canon context` runs → identical context_hash.

points.note: receipt_deterministic_given_inputs: automated determinism test
dependency list: fs2, serde_json, sha2, ed25519-dalek, rand_core/getrandom — zero network, zero model calls

invariants.statement: Authority is explicit. Every authoritative record has an identifiable origin.
invariants.scope: All CANON records and their references.
invariants.authority: CANON constitution (RFC-002 §6 I12; RFC-002 §32 authority matrix).
invariants.enforcement_point: Every record carries actor + created_at (UTC ISO); contracts validate constitution/decision refs on append; audit re-checks dangling refs.
invariants.violation_behavior: Dangling constitution ref → exit 4; anonymous mutation via the API is impossible (actor always stamped).
